title: ActionStream ROS 2 / Isaac Sim Runtime Integration

runtime.action_representation: absolute [x, y, z, axis-angle x, axis-angle y, axis-angle z, gripper]
runtime.safe_hold: repeat the last finite canonical 7D command; the episode's explicit initial command is used before the first execution

action_time_contract.observation_step: O is the last completed simulation/control step
action_time_contract.target_steps: a chunk from observation O explicitly targets O+1 through O+30
action_time_contract.expired_action: target_step is less than insertion_step or is already executed
action_time_contract.duplicate_target_resolution: first valid action for a target step wins within a chunk; newer accepted aligned plans atomically replace the executable queue
action_time_contract.generation: an explicit invalidation epoch, not a request identifier; routine periodic requests remain in one generation
action_time_contract.cross_generation_rule: only the active generation may install or execute actions
action_time_contract.episode_rule: messages not matching the active episode are rejected

task.policy: deterministic scripted chunk policy; no learned model or training
task.success: object remains grasped and at least 0.12 m above its initial height for 20 consecutive control steps

classification_constraint: NO-GO if the official Isaac Sim integration cannot be completed, regardless of ROS 2 test-plant results
holdout_policy: No code, task, method, profile, seed, threshold, or statistical changes after the first holdout episode begins. Failed episodes remain in the manifest.
